records.claim: GBD 2023: ~608 million females ever exposed to IPV; 18.5 million DALYs in 2023; among leading risk factors for females 15-49; anxiety and depression major components
Lohmann 2024? systematic review/meta-analysis of 68 studies: coercive control associated with PTSD r~0.32 and depression r~0.27
Scoping review of reproductive coercion, 62 studies, 18 countries: associated with unintended pregnancy, STIs, anxiety, depression, PTSD
FIGO Preconception Checklist: structured framework for health assessment before pregnancy
Systematic review/meta-analysis of premarital sickle-cell screening practice in Africa: substantial heterogeneity in uptake
ACF-funded couple relationship education meta-analysis: small effects on relationship quality, communication, mental health; less evidence for stability

Relationship education and relationship aggression meta-analysis 2023: 31 studies, >25,000 participants; d~0.11 overall, d~0.05 in RCTs only, not statistically convincing; larger in higher-risk samples
Karakurt 2016 couples therapy for IPV SR/MA: preliminary benefit in selected circumstances (situational couple violence), retaliation concerns
USPSTF 2025 evidence review: trials of screening alone vs no screening did not show clear reductions in IPV/health outcomes; instrument sensitivities vary widely
Upadhyay 2014 Reproductive Autonomy Scale: three domains freedom from coercion, communication, decision-making
Cochrane review 2021 training healthcare providers to respond to IPV: improves knowledge/attitudes/preparedness; limited certainty on behaviour and survivor outcomes
Frontiers in Medicine 2023 SR/MA: IPV in pregnancy pooled OR ~1.84 preterm birth, ~2.73 low birth weight; stillbirth less certain
Reproductive Health 2026 SR of couple-based preconception care: 14 studies, 10 countries; heterogeneous; mostly high-income settings
2025 scoping review of premarital thalassaemia educational interventions: consistent knowledge gain; behavioural outcomes (screening uptake) less consistent
2024 Cochrane review of patient decision aids: 209 studies, >107,000 participants; improved knowledge, risk perception, values-congruent choice, participation; reduced decisional conflict
WHO violence against women prevalence estimates 2023: nearly 1 in 3 women 15+ experienced physical/sexual IPV and/or non-partner sexual violence in lifetime
